native.input: exact current execution context and selected batch bytes
native.proof: canonical ISA, active Unicode, universal AST and current composition reconstruction; exact committed generation, root, projection, stored receipt references, active control and contiguous event chain; present historical composition summary consistency
native.stored_reference_rule: Required nonzero 32-byte observed generation references are bound into the new proof, including when the historical composition row is absent. They are not reconstructed historical receipt bodies.
native.historical_composition_receipt_present: A native boolean observation of related composition-row presence; any present link or count mismatch rejects the proof. Legacy absence is explicit and creates no historical rows.
native.historical_coverage_rule: A present composition summary proves consistency only. Original working-set, producer and checkpoint bodies are unavailable, so historical intermediate receipt verification remains false in every accepted result.
native.transaction: native internal subtransaction rolls back all verifier deposition before return; caller commits no registry activation

expected_epoch_coverage.count_rule: Each count is a nonnegative integer; their sum equals activation_sequence. The native proof hashes both counts and each verified event input with its source.
expected_epoch_coverage.retained_rule: New activation events retain the actual request expected epoch transactionally; present values must verify and are never replaced by a fallback.
expected_epoch_coverage.recovered_rule: A missing legacy first input may use zero only when both original native admission and final activation hashes authenticate it. A missing later input uses the verified preceding event epoch. A missing nonzero first input remains unavailable and rejects verification. No historical row is backfilled.
expected_epoch_coverage.historical_scope: Expected-epoch input verification does not verify unavailable original working-set, producer or checkpoint receipt bodies.

receipt.rule: A new current-state proof retains the loss of original request bytes. It cannot recreate historical admission, call active-to-active activation, replace a present invalid request, or relabel a current verification receipt as the original receipt.
